historicalComparison.comparison: Exact Vector3 and Quaternion component equality on every simulated frame

editorMessages:
ArgumentOutOfRangeException: Index was out of range. Must be non-negative and less than the size of the collection.
Parameter name: index

coverage: 27,648 simulated frames compared against the original historical calculation, with exact position and quaternion component equality.
Eight signed/zero/positive gains, three DC offsets, 30/60/120 Hz plus frame-to-frame variable timing; yaw-rate, raw-delta, and force/torque branches.
Constant/changing/signed/unwrapped raw radians, held packets, actual Update with stale input, orientation/position toggles and reset.
ControlScene loads gain 10, advances in place to -2.5, then reloads to omitted default 1; all four Kinefly rigs and six-camera template.
Explicit Kinefly selection survives Swarm/Kannadi gain setup; raw-radian logging and per-rig DC offset persistence checked.
Existing walking regression uses its supported RBLF four-panel hardware fixture.
limitations: No physical Kinefly hardware, network latency, LED display timing, or full historical terrain/wind/autopilot behavior comparison.
UnityEditor.Search.SearchDatabase emitted the recorded startup indexing exception; it did not fail either runtime suite.

The broad walking suite initially failed a JuliusTree Down-camera assertion with a six-camera fixture; its supported RBLF fixture passes. Six-camera Choice gain integration is checked by the historical suite.
